quartzVersion.description: The Quartz version (only present when known)

runningSince.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the scheduler started running (only present when known)

totalCounter.description: The total number of jobs executed (only present when known)

started.description: Whether the scheduler is started (only present when known)

shutdown.description: Whether the scheduler is shutdown (only present when known)

inStandbyMode.description: Whether the scheduler is in standby mode (only present when known)

threadPoolClass.description: The thread pool class name (only present when known)

threadPoolSize.description: The thread pool size (only present when known)

jpbStoreClass.description: The job store class name (field kept as jpbStoreClass for backwards compatibility, only present when known)

jpbStoreClustered.description: Whether the job store is clustered (field kept as jpbStoreClustered for backwards compatibility, only present when known)

jpbStoreSupportsPersistence.description: Whether the job store supports persistence (field kept as jpbStoreSupportsPersistence for backwards compatibility, only present when known)

currentExecutingJobs.description: The number of currently executing jobs

triggerType.description: The trigger type: cron or simple

cron.description: The cron expression (only present for a cron trigger)

routeId.description: The route id (only present when known)

uri.description: The endpoint URI (only present when a cron expression is set)

prevFireTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the previous fire time (only present when known)

fireTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the fire time (only present when known)

nextFireTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the next fire time (only present when known)

finalFireTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the final fire time (only present when known)

refireCount.description: The number of times the job has been refired

jobs.description: Only present when there are any currently executing jobs

routeId.description: The route id (only present when known)

triggerType.description: The trigger type: cron or simple (only present when known)

cron.description: The cron expression (only present when known)

repeatInterval.description: The simple trigger repeat interval (only present when known)

triggers.description: Only present when there are any scheduled triggers
